summary: This Form 6-K filed by Global Ship Lease, Inc., a Marshall Islands-incorporated foreign private issuer, reports routine corporate governance items: the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held June 17, 2026. Shareholders elected three directors (Michael S. Gross, Menno van Lacum, Alain Wils) to term-class positions, ratified PricewaterhouseCoopers S.A. as independent auditor for fiscal 2026, and approved Second Amended and Restated Articles of Incorporation. The filing also notes the company's affirmed credit ratings and upgraded outlook via a separate press release. There are no special-situation elements: no acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes. The filing is entirely ordinary governance, thus no special-situation classification applies.
